Hi Elaine / Mike —

Hope you both had a good week. Our contract with Streamline Health comes up for renewal in late July, and I wanted to kick off planning so we can align on capacity, term length, and the QBR cadence. High level items to cover in the kickoff: 

- Current committed capacity usage and near-term forecast (we have telemetry through the Console).
- Preferred term (12 vs 24 months) and any quarterly commit adjustments.
- Expansion priorities you mentioned in the last call: more inference capacity for real-time triage + embeddings for search.
- Pricing baseline and any add-on professional services/time for migration of older pipelines.
- QBR scheduling: propose dates for a renewal QBR in June/early July to finalize commercial terms before the July renewal window.

Can we lock a 60-minute slot for the initial QBR and renewal conversation? Options next week: 
- Wed 2026-06-09 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-06-10 14:00–15:00 PT
- Mon 2026-06-14 09:00–10:00 PT

I’ve cc’d Marissa (our renewals lead) to bring in pricing/discount guidance. I’ll also bring Rishi from Solutions if we need a quick capacity sizing review.

Attached is a short renewal summary and our current usage snapshot so you have context before the call. If you prefer I can prepare a recommended capacity + upsell package (3 options: conservative / expected / aggressive) for the meeting.

Thanks — looking forward to locking in dates.

Sean / Rishi —

Forwarding Elaine’s confirmation. For prep: I recommend we prepare three packages: 

A) Conserved: +10% committed capacity, 12-month term, marginal discount on hosted units, no PS hours.
B) Growth: +25% committed capacity, 12–18 month effective pricing (12-month with 6-month option to renew), includes 40 PS hours for migration/tuning, small onboarding credit.
C) Strategic: +50% committed capacity, 24-month term, steeper per-token discount, priority Dedicated capacity window, and 80 PS hours plus one technical QBR per quarter.

Also: we should table an alternate elastic model (reserved baseline + burst credits) for them to avoid over-committing if they prefer flexibility. 

Rishi — can you put together a short latency + cost delta table showing expected 1.25x and 1.5x reserve scenarios for the Thu meeting? Keep it two slides: latency impact (p95) and cost per 1M tokens. I’ll draft the commercial slide and suggest discount ranges.
